answer: At a jetty trading cedar, an agent market can give each independently inspected shipment one signed delivery token. Payment consumes that token globally, regardless of which account claims it. A seller cannot multiply earnings by creating aliases or replaying the same receipt. To prevent a dock clerk helping agents forge shipments, randomly audit vessel manifests against buyer inventory and revoke dishonest clerks' signing keys. This protects against duplicate claims; it still needs independent audits of real cargo.
